harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed AIDE on node1, configured /etc/aide.conf to scope the ruleset to /etc with a strong attribute set (perms, inode, links, uid/gid, size, mtime, ctime, acl, selinux, xattrs, sha256), initialized the baseline database at /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz, and validated detection with a smoke test (new file correctly flagged, then cleaned up). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, scheduled and acknowledged a systemd reboot, polled until reachable again, and confirmed the boot_id changed. Post-restart, AIDE correctly flagged expected boot-time metadata churn (ctime on /etc, /etc/issue, /etc/locale.conf, /etc/mtab, /etc/nsswitch.conf, /etc/os-release, /etc/pam.d, /etc/resolv.conf) proving the integrity mechanism works end-to-end, then re-initialized the baseline against this stable post-boot state so the persisted baseline reflects current-state /etc with a final clean check.
actions_performed: Installed aide package on node1 via dnf
Rewrote /etc/aide.conf (backed up original) scoping monitoring to /etc with All=p+i+n+u+g+s+m+c+acl+selinux+xattrs+sha256
Initialized AIDE database and promoted it to /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
Ran aide --check to confirm a clean baseline
Created and removed /etc/aide-integrity-smoketest.conf to prove change detection works
Captured pre-restart boot_id and AIDE health baseline
Scheduled and acknowledged a systemd reboot on node1
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed, confirming an actual restart
Verified AIDE db and config persisted across reboot and detected real boot-time /etc metadata changes
Re-initialized the AIDE baseline against the stable post-restart state and confirmed a final clean check

evidence.requirement: AIDE installed and configured to monitor /etc
evidence.summary: Installed aide via dnf; diagnosed and fixed aide.conf syntax (database_in vs invalid 'database' key) scoping rules to /etc
aide --init created /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz (1187 entries under /etc), promoted to active db, sha256 captured

evidence.requirement: Baseline correctly detects later changes to /etc
evidence.summary: Clean aide --check on fresh baseline, then smoke-test file /etc/aide-integrity-smoketest.conf flagged as 'f+++++++++++++++++', then removed

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline evidence for node1
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 513c865e-e121-4025-a0a4-8689cc580398, aide db present/hashed, clean aide --check
systemd-run scheduled systemctl reboot; command acknowledged before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart of node1
evidence.summary: Connection dropped during reboot, then timed out, then recovered with new boot_id 00b4c886-ea0f-4597-b951-e80696e9bdd5 (differs from pre-restart 513c865e...)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and final integrity baseline for /etc on node1
evidence.summary: AIDE db/config persisted across reboot; check correctly flagged real boot-time ctime churn in /etc, proving detection works; baseline re-initialized against stable post-boot state with a final clean aide --check
